notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, attempting to deal 100 damage to Crystalline Crawler, which will result in 100 +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
